name: Juku-Juku
source:
She suddenly appears in front of the main character, Mihoshiku Hime no Mikoto (Princess Mihoshiku no Mikoto), also known as Juku-Juku. She encourages the protagonists to engage in sexual activity to restore her diminished power. It is said that when her power is depleted, a curse of lewdness spreads in the surrounding area.

「Oh, no, my sex power is running out!」
